## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(macos): …`, `fix(windows): …`)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Builds and tests pass locally for the platforms I touched
- [ ] Protocol changes update `protocol/schemas/`, `protocol/fixtures/` and the version history in `protocol/README.md`
- [ ] Architecture or scope changes have an ADR in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] No secrets, signing material or binaries committed
